title: FalsegreenFixValidation
description: The verdict of the bidirectional gate that decides whether a strengthened test proposed by the skill's AI-fix mode (Mode C) is accepted. The skill proposes the fix and this validation contract; the host or developer runs the gate (suite rerun or targeted mutation, via mutmut/cosmic-ray for Python or Stryker for JS/TS) and fills this object. Decision rule: verdict is accept only when clean_replica is pass AND mutated_replica is fail; every other combination is reject (a test that does not fail on the mutated replica still cannot catch the bug).

finding.description: Reference to the original falsegreen finding this fix addresses, located by catalog code and source position.

code.description: Catalog code or case number of the finding being fixed (e.g., 18, C5, JS21, S3).

file.description: Path to the test file the finding was raised in.

tier.description: Cost tier of the gate run. suite-rerun reruns the whole suite against clean and mutated replicas (cheap, coarse). targeted-mutation applies a focused mutant to the unit under test (costlier, precise).

clean_replica.description: Outcome of the strengthened test on an unmodified (clean) replica of the code. Must be pass for the fix to be accepted.

mutated_replica.description: Outcome of the strengthened test on a replica where the bug class is reintroduced (mutated). Must be fail for the fix to be accepted: the test has to detect the mutation.

verdict.description: Gate decision. accept requires clean_replica=pass AND mutated_replica=fail; any other combination is reject.

mutation.description: Description of the mutant applied to the unit under test (targeted-mutation tier), or the suite mutation operator used.

notes.description: Free-form notes: why a verdict was reached, flaky behavior observed, or the tool and command used.
